MAJOR: Design does not address checklist items 1–10 explicitly (reversibility/backup, availability, authz boundary, blast radius, invariants, tests/rollback, language rule, API decision, tenant isolation, reuse/observability); only rollback/risk notes are present. Pre-empt per CL-008.

CL-006 (Gate 1 must embed latest Gate 1.5 findings + dispositions; approval invalid while BLOCKER/MAJOR is PENDING) is enforced but not represented in affected_files/design; `gate1_check.py` change scope unclear → risk of gate regression.

CL-008/CL-009 (design-time and coding-time learnings injection via `core/design_guardrails.py`, `core/worker.py`, `core/orchestrator/agent_runner.py`) not in scope; delivery-review classes may repeat.

Evidence naming invariant `(item_id, mode, base, head, diff_sha)` vs existing evidence layout: rollback claims "no persisted state migration" but prior evidence files may be orphaned/unreadable → prior-findings/dispositions continuity risk; needs explicit migration/back-compat rule.
"Data-only commit does not invalidate review" lacks rule for fast-forwarding `last_reviewed_head` when diff is empty; evidence stays bound to stale head → subsequent delta base drift.
Determination of "review-relevant diff is empty" is undefined (heuristics/classification); misclassification could silently skip real changes; needs fail-closed, auditable rule.
Test matrix omits coverage for `_render_review`/`_item_dispositions` (index alignment, missing-item, unknown-status paths) — recurring MAJOR; gate output correctness untested.
No explicit handling of secret redaction/retention in evidence JSON despite provider call with env/key-file secrets.
MINOR: Encoding gate scanning index+worktree+untracked risks false positives on large derived artifacts; exclude-lists and allow-exceptions policy not specified.
Observability limited to exit codes/stderr; no structured metrics/trail for delta vs full reviews (e.g., review mode, diff size, gate durations).
Rollout "T1 applies to 1484/1485 only" leaves enforcement migration plan for later items undefined (`enforce_items/enforce_from` semantics underspecified).
Risk-tier config `config/risk-tiers.json` schema/precedence vs `item.risk_tier` not pinned.
NIT: Design-pack generated `engineering/design/<ID>.md` determinism (stable ordering, no timestamps) not stated → diff noise in reviews.
Probe-key uniqueness via wall-clock nanos (recurring) — negligible but note.
SUMMARY: Design is directionally sound (delta reviews, design pack, encoding gate) and respects language rule (tooling Python) and CL-002 (reviewer advisory).
Top risks: guardrail checklist and CL-006/008/009 wiring not evidenced; evidence-chain continuity/migration and empty-diff fast-forward rule undefined; render/disposition test coverage gap.
Recommend resolving MAJORs before Gate 1.5; no blocker-level defect identified.
